schema_ddl:

    PID INT,
    TIV_2015 NUMERIC,
    TIV_2016 NUMERIC,
    LAT NUMERIC,
    LON NUMERIC,
    PRIMARY KEY (PID),
    CHECK (TIV_2015 >= 0),
    CHECK (TIV_2016 >= 0)
);
